picks.editorial_note: MIT's Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins won the prestigious Pritzker Prize for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery, a landmark recognition of AI's real-world impact on combating drug-resistant infections.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: A $24.5 million NSF-funded national project (FabAID) to build AI-driven science infrastructure, with Nebraska leading cybersecurity, represents a significant federal investment and multi-institutional partnership in AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: University to lead cybersecurity for national Fabric for AI-Driven Science project

picks.editorial_note: A $39.5 million ARPA-H-funded consortium spanning Boston University, Philips, Johns Hopkins, and Weill Cornell is developing AI-enabled robotic catheter technology for remote stroke treatment, a major cross-sector investment with direct clinical impact.
picks.title: Brink Bites: Robotic Stroke Surgery, Curbing Junk Food Sales, and American Attitudes On Data Center Construction

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and HSBC's strategic framework agreement to advance AI and financial innovation through a new joint institute exemplifies deepening academia-industry ties in AI commercialization.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge researchers used an AI-guided design technique to create a broad-spectrum bird flu vaccine with complete protection in animal trials, a scientific advance with direct global health implications.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' with Fermilab building agentic AI tools for scientific workflows, signals a significant federal push to operationalize AI across the national lab system.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's pledge of up to $100 billion in equity to the public, alongside SpaceX's similar move, raises major questions about wealth distribution from AI's economic windfall and is drawing serious academic policy analysis.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional team is using AI alongside satellite imaging and health data to study environmental contributors to Alzheimer's and dementia, a scientifically ambitious cross-disciplinary effort.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding for ANU to modernize fusion simulation tools with AI shows industry capital flowing into AI-accelerated energy research, a notable academia-industry partnership.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills from self-generated synthetic data alone, a notable fundamental research result with implications for how future AI systems are trained.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It
